item.title: Add currency-aware per-account totals to reports
item.brief: Update the Python reports program to read currency-aware CSV on stdin and total by account and currency. Output header account,currency,total_cents and rows sorted by account then currency. Accept legacy CSV without a currency column, counting every row as USD. Validate present currency values as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Update README and tests as appropriate, run python3 -m unittest, and commit the change. Preserve existing behavior outside this request.

item.title: Add currency column and validation to ledger TSV export
item.brief: Update the Rust ledger program to parse TSV transaction input with an optional fourth ISO 4217 currency code column. Missing currency defaults to USD. Accept only exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Output CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and include currency on every row. On malformed currency, print an error naming the 1-based input line number to stderr and exit 2; retain exit status 1 for other input errors. Update README and tests as appropriate, run cargo test, and commit the change. Preserve existing behavior outside this request.
